title: Uncertainty as a Proxy for Semantic Correctness in Diffusion-Based Medical Image Synthesis
title_zh: 基于扩散模型的医学图像合成中，不确定性作为语义正确性的代理指标

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models can synthesise contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) from non-contrast CT (NCCT), avoiding contrast administration and its environmental and patient-access costs. However, visually realistic images are not necessarily anatomically correct, and the pixel-intensity and feature-space similarity metrics used to assess generation quality do not directly measure anatomical correctness. In this work, we investigate whether uncertainty can serve as a proxy for semantic correctness in diffusion-based medical image synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型可以从非增强 CT（NCCT）合成增强 CT（CECT），从而避免使用造影剂及其带来的环境和患者可及性成本。 然而，视觉上逼真的图像并不一定在解剖学上是正确的，而用于评估生成质量的像素强度与特征空间相似性指标也无法直接衡量解剖学正确性。 在本研究中，我们探讨了不确定性是否可以作为扩散模型在医学图像合成中语义正确性的替代指标。

paragraphs.en: We study NCCT-to-CECT synthesis using AortaDiff, a multitask diffusion framework that jointly generates CECT images and lumen segmentations. The segmentation output provides an explicit representation of the generated vascular anatomy, enabling segmentation-derived errors to be used as a quantitative measure of generation correctness. Six methods spanning weight (Ensemble, HyperDiff, BayesDiff), architecture-perturbation (MCDropout), generative-stochasticity (RDS) and input-perturbation (TTA) uncertainty are compared at the pixel, region and image levels, and for detection of clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了使用 AortaDiff 进行的 NCCT-to-CECT 合成，这是一种多任务扩散框架，能够同时生成 CECT 图像和血管腔分割结果。 分割输出为生成的血管解剖结构提供了明确的表示，使得基于分割的误差能够被用作衡量生成准确性的量化指标。 我们比较了六种涵盖权重（Ensemble、HyperDiff、BayesDiff）、架构扰动（MCDropout）、生成随机性（RDS）和输入扰动（TTA）不确定性的方法，评估指标包括像素级、区域级和图像级表现，并用于检测临床相关的分布外（OOD）病例。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty proves informative at all three spatial scales, remains informative on an external multi-centre dataset under distribution shift, and supports OOD detection. MCDropout stands out among the six: it ranks among the leading methods at every scale, generalizes well on the external dataset, and can be enabled at inference on any model already trained with dropout, so reliable uncertainty comes at no extra training cost. Uncertainty reliably flags severe failures but discriminates poorly among already high-quality images. These findings support uncertainty as a practical and computationally economical signal for quality filtering, reliability assessment and OOD detection in NCCT-to-CECT synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have recently achieved strong performance in medical image synthesis [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . A clinically important application is the synthesis of contrast-enhanced images from non-contrast scans, including contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) from non-contrast CT (NCCT) [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] and contrast-enhanced from non-contrast MRI [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Contrast administration adds costs beyond the scan itself. Iodinated contrast media are poorly removed by conventional wastewater treatment and are now widely detected as environmental contaminants [ 11 ] . Moreover, concerns about kidney risk may lead to contrast-enhanced studies being withheld from patients with impaired renal function [ 12 ] . Synthesising CECT from NCCT therefore has implications for the environmental footprint, resource resilience, and accessibility of routine vascular imaging.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，扩散模型在医学图像合成方面取得了出色的性能 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 一个具有重要临床意义的应用是从非增强扫描中合成增强图像，包括从非增强 CT（NCCT）合成增强 CT（CECT）[ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ]，以及从非增强 MRI 合成增强图像 [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] 。 使用造影剂会增加除扫描本身之外的额外成本。 碘化造影剂难以通过传统污水处理系统去除，目前已被广泛检测为环境污染物 [ 11 ] 。 此外，对肾脏风险的担忧可能导致肾功能受损的患者无法接受增强检查 [ 12 ] 。 因此，从非增强 CT 合成增强 CT 对常规血管成像的环境影响、资源可持续性和可及性具有重要意义。

paragraphs.en: These benefits depend on the generated vascular anatomy being trustworthy. However, a generated image that appears visually realistic is not necessarily anatomically correct [ 13 ] . Small structural errors in the aorta may lead to incorrect downstream analysis and clinical decisions. Existing image quality metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and MSE measure similarity either between pixel intensities or between feature representations, and do not directly assess whether the generated anatomy is semantically correct [ 14 ] . Therefore, reliable assessment of generation correctness remains an important challenge [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些优势取决于所生成的血管解剖结构是否可靠。 然而，视觉上看似逼真的生成图像并不一定在解剖学上是正确的 [ 13 ] 。 主动脉中的微小结构错误可能导致下游分析和临床决策出现偏差。 现有的图像质量指标（如 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 MSE）衡量的是像素强度或特征表示之间的相似性，并未直接评估生成的解剖结构是否在语义上正确 [ 14 ] 。 因此，可靠地评估生成结果的正确性仍然是一个重要挑战 [ 15 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty in a diffusion model can arise from different sources, and uncertainty estimation methods differ primarily in where stochasticity or variability is introduced [ 16 ] . We therefore organize diffusion-based UQ methods according to four sources: weight uncertainty, which perturbs or samples the learned parameters [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] ; architecture-perturbation uncertainty, which keeps weights fixed but stochastically modifies the computation graph, with Monte Carlo Dropout (MCDropout) as the predominant approach [ 21 ] ; generative-stochasticity uncertainty, which captures the variability of diffusion generation across repeated sampling from different initial noise realizations [ 22 , 23 ] ; and input-perturbation uncertainty, which probes model stability under test-time transformations of the input image [ 24 ] . These sources correspond to the main stages at which variability can enter a sampling-based generation pipeline: the model parameters, the network computation, the diffusion sampling process, and the input condition.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型中的不确定性可能源于不同来源，而不确定性估计方法的主要区别在于随机性或变异性被引入的位置 [ 16 ]。 因此，我们根据四个来源对基于扩散的不确定性量化（UQ）方法进行分类：权重不确定性，即扰动或采样已学习的参数 [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ]；架构扰动不确定性，即保持权重固定但随机修改计算图，其中蒙特卡洛丢弃（MCDropout）是主要方法 [ 21 ]；生成随机性不确定性，即捕捉在不同初始噪声实现下重复采样时扩散生成过程的变异性 [ 22 , 23 ]；以及输入扰动不确定性，即探究模型在测试时对输入图像进行变换时的稳定性 [ 24 ]。 这些来源对应于采样式生成流程中可能引入变异性的主要阶段：模型参数、网络计算、扩散采样过程以及输入条件。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluations of uncertainty in medical image generation do not test it against semantic correctness, i.e. whether the generated anatomy matches the ground truth. Some measure error as pixel-intensity or feature-space dissimilarity between generated and reference images, using metrics such as MAE, SSIM and LPIPS [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] , which capture anatomical error only indirectly. Others validate uncertainty against distribution-level scores such as FID under synthetically degraded inputs [ 29 ] . To our knowledge, no study establishes whether uncertainty corresponds to semantic errors in the generated anatomy.
paragraphs.zh: 现有对医学图像生成中不确定性的评估并未检验其语义正确性，即生成的解剖结构是否与真实数据匹配。 一些研究通过测量生成图像与参考图像之间的像素强度或特征空间差异来评估误差，使用的指标包括 MAE、SSIM 和 LPIPS [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ]，但这些指标仅能间接反映解剖学上的误差。 另一些研究则通过合成退化输入下的 FID 等分布级评分来验证不确定性 [ 29 ]。 据我们所知，目前尚无研究证实不确定性是否与生成解剖结构中的语义错误存在对应关系。

paragraphs.en: We study these uncertainty quantification methods using a multitask diffusion framework for NCCT to CECT synthesis [ 30 ] . The model jointly generates a CECT image and a lumen segmentation mask, as shown in Figure 1 . This provides a natural way to evaluate semantic correctness because the segmentation output directly reflects the generated aorta structure. We show that the multitask model’s segmentation output agrees closely with three independently trained external segmentation networks (nnU-Net, UNet++ and Attention U-Net [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] ) applied to the generated image, confirming that the segmentation branch faithfully reflects the generated vascular anatomy. Its agreement with the ground-truth lumen therefore provides a measure of generation correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一种用于 NCCT 到 CECT 合成的多任务扩散框架来研究这些不确定性量化方法 [30]。 该模型会联合生成一张 CECT 图像和一个管腔分割掩码，如圖 1 所示。 这为评估语义正确性提供了一种自然的方式，因为分割输出直接反映了生成的主动脉结构。 我们证明了，多任务模型的分割输出与三个独立训练的外部分割网络（nnU-Net、UNet++ 和 Attention U-Net [31, 32, 33]）应用于生成图像后的结果高度一致，从而证实了分割分支忠实地反映了生成的血管解剖结构。 因此，它与真实管腔的一致性为评估生成结果的正确性提供了一种衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: Using this framework, we systematically evaluate representative uncertainty estimation methods for diffusion models. We perform a multi-scale evaluation that studies uncertainty at the pixel, region, and image level, and assess whether uncertainty can detect clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases, specifically vascular stents, on an external multi-center dataset. Together, these analyses reveal whether uncertainty corresponds to local semantic errors, whether it can flag failed generations, and whether it remains consistent on an external dataset and identifies OOD cases under distribution shift.
paragraphs.zh: 借助这一框架，我们系统性地评估了扩散模型中具有代表性的不确定性估计方法。 我们进行了多尺度评估，研究像素、区域和图像层面的不确定性，并检验不确定性是否能够在外部多中心数据集上检测出具有临床相关性的分布外（OOD）案例，特别是血管支架。 综合这些分析，我们可以了解不确定性是否与局部语义错误相对应，是否能够标记生成失败的情况，以及在外部数据集上是否保持一致性，并在分布偏移的情况下识别出 OOD 案例。

sents.zh: 我们进行了多尺度评估，研究像素、区域和图像层面的不确定性，并检验不确定性是否能够在外部多中心数据集上检测出具有临床相关性的分布外（OOD）案例，特别是血管支架。

sents.en: Together, these analyses reveal whether uncertainty corresponds to local semantic errors, whether it can flag failed generations, and whether it remains consistent on an external dataset and identifies OOD cases under distribution shift.
sents.zh: 综合这些分析，我们可以了解不确定性是否与局部语义错误相对应，是否能够标记生成失败的情况，以及在外部数据集上是否保持一致性，并在分布偏移的情况下识别出 OOD 案例。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments lead to three main findings. First, uncertainty provides meaningful information about semantic correctness at the pixel, region and image levels, and is most informative for severe generation failures. This information is preserved on an external multi-centre dataset, where image-level failure detection remains effective. Second, MCDropout ranks among the leading methods at every scale. When the base model is trained with dropout, reliable uncertainty estimates can be obtained without training additional networks. Third, uncertainty maps can be aggregated into image-level scores for quality filtering and for detecting clinically relevant OOD structures such as vascular stents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验得出了三个主要发现。 首先，不确定性在像素、区域和图像层面提供了有关语义正确性的有效信息，并且在严重的生成失败情况下最具信息价值。 这些信息在一个外部多中心数据集上得到了保留，在该数据集上，图像层面的失败检测仍然有效。 其次，MCDropout 在所有尺度上都位列领先方法之中。 当基础模型使用 dropout 进行训练时，无需训练额外网络即可获得可靠的不确定性估计。 第三，不确定性地图可以汇总为图像级别的分数，用于质量过滤以及检测临床相关的 OOD 结构（例如血管支架）。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We propose an evaluation framework that tests diffusion model generation uncertainty against semantic correctness, measured by agreement with the ground-truth anatomy rather than image similarity, using the lumen segmentation jointly predicted by a multitask diffusion model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种评估框架，该框架通过多任务扩散模型联合预测的管腔分割结果，将扩散模型生成的不确定性与其语义正确性进行对比测试。其中，语义正确性的衡量标准是与真实解剖结构的吻合度，而非图像相似性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a multi-scale evaluation protocol spanning the pixel, region and image levels, extended to external multi-centre data under distribution shift and to detection of clinically relevant OOD cases (vascular stents).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种涵盖像素、区域和图像层级的多尺度评估协议，并将其扩展至分布偏移下的外部多中心数据，以及临床相关的 OOD 病例（血管支架）检测。

paragraphs.en: We compare six uncertainty quantification methods for diffusion models, spanning four sources of uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了六种扩散模型的不确定性量化方法，这些方法涵盖了四种不确定性来源。

paragraphs.en: We show that MCDropout remains among the leading methods at every scale and under distribution shift, requiring no additional training when the base model is trained with dropout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，无论模型规模大小或是否存在分布偏移，MCDropout 始终位列领先方法之中；当基础模型采用 dropout 训练时，它无需任何额外训练。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty in diffusion models can arise from model parameters, input perturbations, architectural perturbations, and stochasticity in the diffusion sampling process [ 16 ] . We therefore evaluate representative methods from these four sources: weight uncertainty (BayesDiff, HyperDiff, and deep ensembles), input perturbation (TTA), architecture perturbation (MC Dropout), and generative stochasticity (repeated DDIM sampling).
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型中的不确定性可能源于模型参数、输入扰动、架构扰动以及扩散采样过程中的随机性 [ 16 ]。 因此，我们评估了来自这四个来源的代表性方法：权重不确定性（BayesDiff、HyperDiff 和深度集成）、输入扰动（TTA）、架构扰动（MC Dropout）以及生成随机性（重复的 DDIM 采样）。

sents.en: Uncertainty in diffusion models can arise from model parameters, input perturbations, architectural perturbations, and stochasticity in the diffusion sampling process [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 扩散模型中的不确定性可能源于模型参数、输入扰动、架构扰动以及扩散采样过程中的随机性 [ 16 ]。

sents.en: We therefore evaluate representative methods from these four sources: weight uncertainty (BayesDiff, HyperDiff, and deep ensembles), input perturbation (TTA), architecture perturbation (MC Dropout), and generative stochasticity (repeated DDIM sampling).

paragraphs.en: Weight uncertainty models variability in the learned parameters and assumes that parameter disagreement propagates to uncertainty in the generated output [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] . We consider three approaches with complementary implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 权重不确定性模型描述了已学习参数中的变异性，并假设参数之间的不一致性会传递到生成输出的不确定性中 [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] 。 我们考虑了三种具有互补实现的方案。

sents.en: Weight uncertainty models variability in the learned parameters and assumes that parameter disagreement propagates to uncertainty in the generated output [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] .
sents.zh: 权重不确定性模型描述了已学习参数中的变异性，并假设参数之间的不一致性会传递到生成输出的不确定性中 [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] 。

sents.en: We consider three approaches with complementary implementations.
sents.zh: 我们考虑了三种具有互补实现的方案。

paragraphs.en: BayesDiff [ 19 ] applies a last-layer Laplace approximation (LLLA) [ 34 ] to the diffusion noise-prediction network, fitting a Gaussian posterior around the pre-trained final layer. The resulting predictive variance is propagated through the reverse diffusion process, with the covariance term estimated by Monte Carlo sampling, yielding a pixel-wise uncertainty map.
paragraphs.zh: BayesDiff [ 19 ] 将最后一层拉普拉斯近似（LLLA）[ 34 ] 应用于扩散噪声预测网络，在预训练的最终层周围拟合一个高斯后验分布。 由此得到的预测方差会反向传播至整个逆扩散过程，其协方差项通过蒙特卡洛采样进行估计，最终生成一个像素级的不确定性图。

sents.en: BayesDiff [ 19 ] applies a last-layer Laplace approximation (LLLA) [ 34 ] to the diffusion noise-prediction network, fitting a Gaussian posterior around the pre-trained final layer.
sents.zh: BayesDiff [ 19 ] 将最后一层拉普拉斯近似（LLLA）[ 34 ] 应用于扩散噪声预测网络，在预训练的最终层周围拟合一个高斯后验分布。

paragraphs.en: HyperDiff [ 20 ] uses a Bayesian hypernetwork [ 35 ] to generate plausible weights for the diffusion denoising network. Epistemic uncertainty is obtained from variation across sampled weights, while aleatoric uncertainty captures variation within each weight configuration.
paragraphs.zh: HyperDiff [ 20 ] 使用贝叶斯超网络 [ 35 ] 为扩散去噪网络生成合理的权重。 认识论不确定性来自采样权重的差异，而随机不确定性则捕捉每个权重配置内部的差异。

sents.en: HyperDiff [ 20 ] uses a Bayesian hypernetwork [ 35 ] to generate plausible weights for the diffusion denoising network.
sents.zh: HyperDiff [ 20 ] 使用贝叶斯超网络 [ 35 ] 为扩散去噪网络生成合理的权重。

sents.en: Epistemic uncertainty is obtained from variation across sampled weights, while aleatoric uncertainty captures variation within each weight configuration.
sents.zh: 认识论不确定性来自采样权重的差异，而随机不确定性则捕捉每个权重配置内部的差异。

paragraphs.en: Deep ensembles [ 18 ] approximate weight uncertainty by independently training multiple models and measuring disagreement among their predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 深度集成 [ 18 ] 通过独立训练多个模型并衡量其预测之间的分歧来近似权重不确定性。

paragraphs.en: Input perturbation uncertainty measures model sensitivity to plausible changes in the input. Test-time augmentation (TTA) [ 24 ] generates multiple predictions from randomly transformed inputs and estimates uncertainty from their variability. Unlike weight-based approaches, TTA keeps the model parameters fixed and probes sensitivity to input perturbations.
paragraphs.zh: 输入扰动不确定性衡量了模型对输入中合理变化的敏感度。 测试时增强（TTA）[ 24 ] 通过对随机变换的输入生成多个预测，并根据这些预测的变化性来估计不确定性。 与基于权重的方法不同，TTA 保持模型参数固定，并探测其对输入扰动的敏感度。

sents.en: Input perturbation uncertainty measures model sensitivity to plausible changes in the input.
sents.zh: 输入扰动不确定性衡量了模型对输入中合理变化的敏感度。

sents.en: Test-time augmentation (TTA) [ 24 ] generates multiple predictions from randomly transformed inputs and estimates uncertainty from their variability.

sents.zh: 与基于权重的方法不同，TTA 保持模型参数固定，并探测其对输入扰动的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: Architecture perturbation uncertainty estimates reliability by introducing stochasticity into the network computation during inference. Monte Carlo Dropout (MCDropout) [ 21 ] keeps dropout active during inference, producing different effective subnetworks across repeated forward passes. Uncertainty is estimated from the variability of the resulting predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 架构扰动不确定性通过在推理过程中向网络计算引入随机性来评估可靠性。 蒙特卡洛丢弃（MCDropout）[ 21 ] 在推理期间保持丢弃机制活跃，从而在重复的前向传播中生成不同的有效子网络。 不确定性通过结果预测的变异性进行估计。

sents.zh: 架构扰动不确定性通过在推理过程中向网络计算引入随机性来评估可靠性。

sents.en: Monte Carlo Dropout (MCDropout) [ 21 ] keeps dropout active during inference, producing different effective subnetworks across repeated forward passes.

sents.en: Uncertainty is estimated from the variability of the resulting predictions.
sents.zh: 不确定性通过结果预测的变异性进行估计。

paragraphs.en: Generative stochasticity captures variability arising from the diffusion sampling process. We use repeated deterministic DDIM sampling (RDS) [ 23 ] with different initial noise realizations. Because the reverse process is deterministic given the initial noise, variability across samples reflects differences in the initial noise and provides a direct measure of generation diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 生成性随机性捕捉了扩散采样过程中产生的变异性。 我们使用重复的确定性 DDIM 采样（RDS）[23]，并采用不同的初始噪声实现。 由于在给定初始噪声的情况下，反向过程是确定性的，因此样本间的变异性反映了初始噪声的差异，并为生成多样性提供了直接衡量标准。

sents.zh: 生成性随机性捕捉了扩散采样过程中产生的变异性。

paragraphs.en: We study uncertainty quantification in the setting of NCCT to CECT synthesis of the abdominal aorta. Given an NCCT slice, a multitask diffusion model jointly predicts a synthetic CECT image and a lumen segmentation mask, as shown in Fig. 1 [ 30 ] . The two tasks are optimised simultaneously and share a common image representation, so the segmentation output provides an explicit representation of the lumen structure present in the generated image. This allows segmentation-derived errors to be used as a semantic proxy for generation correctness, rather than the appearance similarity measured by PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了在腹部主动脉的 NCCT 到 CECT 合成场景中的不确定性量化问题。 给定一个 NCCT 切片，一个多任务扩散模型会联合预测一张合成的 CECT 图像和一个管腔分割掩码，如 Fig. 1 [ 30 ] 所示。 这两个任务是同时优化的，并且共享一个共同的图像表示，因此分割输出为生成的图像中存在的管腔结构提供了一个明确的表示。 这使得源自分割的错误能够被用作生成正确性的语义代理，而不是通过 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 测量的外观相似性。

paragraphs.en: In addition to semantic correctness, we investigate whether uncertainty can identify clinically relevant out-of-distribution (OOD) cases. It evaluates whether uncertainty can detect previously unseen structures that were not present during training.
paragraphs.zh: 除了语义正确性之外，我们还研究了不确定性是否能够识别临床相关的分布外（OOD）病例。 它评估了不确定性是否能够检测出训练期间未曾出现过的、此前未见过的结构。

Pixel-wise uncertainty maps are aggregated into image-level uncertainty scores and used to classify stent-containing and non-stent slices. Detection performance is quantified using AUROC.

paragraphs.en: Together, the semantic correctness and OOD evaluations provide a comprehensive assessment of whether uncertainty can be used as a reliability signal for diffusion-based medical image synthesis, both for identifying semantic errors and for detecting clinically relevant distribution shifts.
paragraphs.zh: 语义正确性和分布外（OOD）评估共同提供了一项全面性评价，用于判断不确定性是否可以作为扩散模型生成医学图像时的可靠性信号，既可用于识别语义错误，也可用于检测具有临床相关性的分布偏移。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we use two datasets containing paired NCCT and CECT scans. Both datasets were acquired with full regulatory approval, which enabled secondary use of imaging data acquired as part of the routine healthcare service. The Oxford dataset (UK Health Research Authority Approval Ref: 13/SC/0250) is used for model training and in-distribution evaluation, while the AICT dataset (UK Health Research Authority Approval Ref: 22/HRA/2303) serves as an external validation dataset for evaluating the relationship between uncertainty and semantic error under distribution shift and OOD detection. The two datasets were collected from different clinical sites and imaging scanners providing a realistic setting for assessing the robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们使用了两个包含成对 NCCT 和 CECT 扫描的数据集。 这两个数据集均在获得完全监管批准的情况下获取，这使得作为常规医疗服务一部分采集的影像数据得以二次使用。 牛津数据集（英国卫生研究管理局批准编号：13/SC/0250）用于模型训练和分布内评估，而 AICT 数据集（英国卫生研究管理局批准编号：22/HRA/2303）则作为外部验证数据集，用于评估在分布偏移和 OOD 检测条件下不确定性与语义错误之间的关系。 这两个数据集分别来自不同的临床机构和影像扫描仪，为评估模型的鲁棒性提供了真实的场景。

paragraphs.en: The Oxford dataset is underpinned by the Oxford Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (OxAAA) Study [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . It consists of 264 patient cases, each containing spatially registered NCCT and CECT scans. Aortic segmentation labels are available for all cases, while 65 cases additionally contain expert-annotated lumen segmentations.
paragraphs.zh: 牛津数据集以牛津腹主动脉瘤（OxAAA）研究为基础 [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] 。 该数据集包含 264 例患者病例，每例均包含空间配准的 NCCT 和 CECT 扫描图像。 所有病例均可获取主动脉分割标签，其中 65 例还额外包含专家标注的管腔分割信息。

sents.zh: 牛津数据集以牛津腹主动脉瘤（OxAAA）研究为基础 [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] 。

For model development and evaluation, volumetric scans were processed as independent 2D axial slices. The 20 test cases yielded a total of 1,547 paired NCCT–CECT slices.

paragraphs.en: Slices were retained only if the Dice coefficient between the registered NCCT and CECT aorta masks exceeded 0.90, leaving 1,316 slices in the final test set.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当配准后的 NCCT 和 CECT 主动脉掩膜之间的 Dice 系数超过 0.90 时，才会保留该切片，最终测试集保留了 1,316 个切片。

paragraphs.en: The AICT repository is sourced from 10 hospitals across 3 continents (www.aict.ai). It is used as an external dataset to evaluate the generalizability of uncertainty estimation under data distribution shift. The dataset contains paired NCCT and CECT scans acquired from multiple clinical centers using different scanners and acquisition protocols.

paragraphs.en: As expert lumen annotations were not available, automated segmentation methods were used during preprocessing. First, NCCT and CECT volumes were aligned using rigid registration. Aortic segmentations were first generated using an nnU-Net model [ 31 ] trained on the Oxford dataset [ 39 ] , and each result was manually inspected. When the nnU-Net segmentation was judged inadequate, TotalSegmentator [ 40 ] was applied as a fallback and used if it produced a satisfactory mask; cases for which neither method yielded an acceptable aortic segmentation were discarded. Lumen segmentations were generated using another nnU-Net model trained on the Oxford dataset, and each mask was manually reviewed.
paragraphs.zh: 由于没有可用的专家血管腔标注数据，因此在预处理阶段使用了自动分割方法。 首先，使用刚性配准对齐了 NCCT 和 CECT 体积数据。 首先使用在牛津数据集 [39] 上训练的 nnU-Net 模型 [31] 生成主动脉分割结果，并对每个结果进行了人工检查。 当 nnU-Net 的分割结果被认为不足时，则采用 TotalSegmentator [40] 作为备用方案；如果该方法生成了令人满意的掩膜，则会使用它；对于两种方法都无法产生可接受的主动脉分割结果的病例，则予以舍弃。 血管腔的分割结果使用另一个在牛津数据集上训练的 nnU-Net 模型生成，并对每个掩膜进行了人工审核。

paragraphs.en: Quality control was subsequently performed to ensure adequate image quality and successful preprocessing. Cases were retained only if: (i) the CECT scan exhibited sufficient vascular enhancement to allow clear visualization of the aortic lumen; (ii) the scan contained the abdominal aorta; (iii) NCCT and CECT volumes could be successfully aligned using rigid registration; (iv) at least one automated segmentation method successfully extracted the aortic mask; and (v) the Dice similarity coefficient between the registered NCCT and CECT aortic masks exceeded 0.90. In addition to the above quality-control criteria, all retained slices and the corresponding automatically generated aortic and lumen segmentation masks were manually reviewed.
paragraphs.zh: 随后进行了质量控制，以确保图像质量充足且预处理成功。 仅满足以下条件的病例才会被保留：(i) CECT 扫描显示出足够的血管增强，以便清晰显示主动脉腔；(ii) 扫描包含腹主动脉；(iii) 使用刚性配准能够成功对齐 NCCT 和 CECT 的体数据；(iv) 至少有一种自动分割方法成功提取了主动脉掩膜；以及 (v) 经过配准的 NCCT 和 CECT 主动脉掩膜之间的 Dice 相似性系数超过 0.90。 除上述质量控制标准外，所有保留的切片以及相应自动生成的主动脉和腔内分割掩膜均经过了人工审核。

paragraphs.en: After preprocessing and quality control, 61 cases were retained for analysis. The final cohort consisted of 21 cases from Opole, Poland; 18 from Leicester, UK; 17 from Heraklion, Greece; 3 from São Paulo, Brazil, and 2 from Brugge, Belgium. paragraphs.en: The proxy additionally requires that the segmentation branch reflect the lumen structure present in the model’s jointly generated image. paragraphs.en: In this section, we investigate whether generation uncertainty corresponds to semantic correctness. Specifically, we examine whether high uncertainty is associated with prediction errors, while low uncertainty corresponds to correct predictions. We systematically evaluate this relationship at three different scales: pixel-level, region-level, and image-level.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们研究生成不确定性是否与语义正确性相对应。 具体来说，我们考察高不确定性是否与预测错误相关，而低不确定性是否对应正确的预测。 我们在三个不同尺度上系统性地评估这种关系：像素级、区域级和图像级。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty provides meaningful information about semantic correctness in diffusion-based CECT synthesis, and can additionally identify clinically relevant out-of-distribution cases. Among the methods evaluated, MCDropout emerges as the method of choice: it performs strongly at every scale and under distribution shift, and requires no additional training when the base model already contains dropout, making it the practical default. In practice this makes MCDropout potentially deployable: a single uncertainty map, produced without retraining, lets clinicians flag suspect pixels, localize regions likely to contain errors, and reject unreliable generations.
paragraphs.zh: 不确定性为基于扩散的 CECT 合成中的语义正确性提供了有意义的信息，并且还能识别出具有临床相关性的分布外案例。 在评估的方法中，MCDropout 脱颖而出成为首选方法：它在各种规模和数据分布偏移下均表现优异，并且如果基础模型已包含 dropout，则无需额外训练，因此成为实用的默认选择。 实际上，这使得 MCDropout 具备潜在的部署可能性：一张无需重新训练即可生成的不确定性地图，就能让临床医生标记可疑像素、定位可能包含错误的区域，并拒绝不可靠的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: These differences follow from the source each method estimates. BayesDiff places a posterior on the final convolutional layer alone, treating all preceding layers as a fixed feature extractor, so its uncertainty reflects one layer rather than the full denoiser — a plausible explanation for its consistently weak performance and its negative region-level correlation. Ensemble and HyperDiff instead capture variability across the entire network, and HyperDiff concentrates it within spatially coherent regions, consistent with its region-level strength. MCDropout produces many closely related subnetworks whose disagreement varies smoothly across neighbouring pixels, consistent with its stable pixel-level correspondence. TTA reflects sensitivity to input changes, aligning with its OOD performance, since unseen structures introduce input characteristics the model is less robust to. RDS reflects output diversity across initial noise realizations, and greater variability tends to indicate lower-quality generations. The most appropriate method therefore depends on the intended clinical application.
paragraphs.zh: 这些差异源于每种方法所估计的来源。 BayesDiff仅对最终的卷积层赋予后验分布，将所有前一层视为固定的特征提取器，因此其不确定性反映的是单个层而非整个去噪模型——这可以合理地解释其性能始终较弱以及其在区域层面呈现负相关性的原因。 相比之下，Ensemble和HyperDiff能够捕捉整个网络中的变异性，而HyperDiff则将其集中在空间上连贯的区域中，这与它在区域层面的强大表现一致。 MCDropout会生成许多彼此密切相关的子网络，这些子网络之间的分歧在相邻像素间平滑变化，与其稳定的像素级对应关系一致。 TTA反映了模型对输入变化的敏感性，这与它在OOD（分布外）场景下的表现相符，因为未见过的结构会引入模型较不稳健的输入特征。 RDS反映了初始噪声实现中输出的多样性，而更大的变异性往往意味着生成质量较低。 因此，最恰当的方法取决于预期的临床应用场景。

paragraphs.en: Computational requirements differ substantially (Table I ). TTA and RDS apply directly to any pretrained model, and MCDropout is likewise training-free when the base model was trained with dropout, whereas Ensemble and HyperDiff require additional training. Since the training-free methods match or exceed the retraining-based ones at every scale, deployment-time reliability assessment need not carry a retraining cost — relevant where computational budget or energy footprint constrains clinical deployment.

paragraphs.en: Several limitations should be acknowledged. The experiments were conducted on a single application, NCCT to CECT synthesis of the abdominal aorta, and generalizability to other organs, modalities and generation problems remains to be validated empirically. We expect the analysis to translate, since many medical image generation tasks involve anatomically meaningful structures whose correctness can be quantified through task-specific segmentations or structural measurements, and the framework is independent of the particular segmentation formulation used. In deployment, the estimates studied here may help identify unreliable generations, localize likely semantic errors, and alert clinicians to out-of-distribution structures or artifacts. More broadly, these results suggest that uncertainty should be treated not as a single quantity but as a multi-scale reliability signal, with different mechanisms providing complementary information about a generated image. The evaluation framework proposed here offers a systematic way to study that signal in diffusion-based medical image synthesis, and may support the development of more reliable and deployable generative models for clinical use.
paragraphs.zh: 需要认识到存在若干局限性。 实验仅针对单一应用——腹部主动脉的 NCCT 到 CECT 合成——进行，其对其他器官、模态及生成问题的泛化能力仍有待通过实证加以验证。 我们预计这一分析方法可以推广，因为许多医学图像生成任务都涉及具有解剖学意义的结构，而这些结构的正确性可以通过特定任务的分割或结构测量进行量化，且该框架与所使用的具体分割方法无关。 在实际部署中，本文研究的估计值可能有助于识别不可靠的生成结果、定位潜在的语义错误，并提醒临床医生注意分布外的结构或伪影。 更广泛地说，这些结果表明，不确定性不应被视为单一数值，而应被视作一种多尺度的可靠性信号，其中不同机制可提供关于生成图像的互补信息。 本文提出的评估框架为在基于扩散的医学图像合成中研究该信号提供了一种系统性方法，并可能支持开发更具可靠性且适用于临床部署的生成模型。
